notes: Tabs keep their state. Switching away from a tab and back no longer resets it — a fetched preview, discovered sync pairs, or half-filled inputs stay as you left them. Sync now compares both systems. In addition to Jira issues with the chosen fix version, it also lists the FogBugz cases in the matching milestone and merges in any whose Jira issue has a different fix version — so a case moved on only one side is no longer invisible. FogBugz cases in the milestone with no usable Jira link are listed separately.
